input.content: # Plan — Sidebar Slim-Down + Settings Page Redesign (Polaris) ## Context Pinzo's Shopify embedded admin currently exposes **9 flat links** in the App Bridge `` ([app/routes/app.tsx:104-114](app/routes/app.tsx#L104-L114)). Yash finds this noisy and not aligned with the actual workflow. Shopify's own NavMenu guidance recommends ≤7 top-level items grouped by frequency-of-use. Separately, the Settings page ([app/routes/app.settings.tsx](app/routes/app.settings.tsx)) uses a horizontal `` strip with 4 tabs including a **"Setup Guide"** that duplicates the standalone `/app/onboarding` wizard ([app/routes/app.onboarding.tsx](app/routes/app.onboarding.tsx)) and the dashboard banner ([app/routes/app._index.tsx:255-265](app/routes/app._index.tsx#L255-L265)). Yash wants the Setup Guide removed from Settings, and the page restructured with a proper Polaris **left-sidebar** sub-navigation (industry standard for settings pages, used by Shopify Admin itself). Outcome: cleaner mental model — top sidebar = workflow surfaces, Settings page = sectioned config with vertical sub-nav. --- ## Change 1 — Slim the App Bridge sidebar (9 → 7 items, workflow order) **File:** [app/routes/app.tsx:104-114](app/routes/app.tsx#L104-L114) NavMenu is flat by design (App Bridge does not support nested groups), so reduction comes from (a) re-ordering by daily workflow, (b) shortening labels, (c) relocating two low-frequency items into Settings. **New menu (7 items, workflow order — Monitor → Configure → Customize → Account):** ```tsx Dashboard Analytics Zip Codes Delivery Rules Widget Waitlist Settings ``` **Removed from sidebar (relocated into Settings sub-nav, see Change 3):** - `Feature Requests` → Settings section - `Help & Support` → Settings section **Label change:** `Widget Customization` → `Widget` (already includes visibility per recent merge commit `f729381`). **Routes themselves are NOT deleted** — `/app/feature-requests` and `/app/help` continue to exist and remain reachable via the new Settings left-nav links. This avoids breaking any deep links or redirects. --- ## Change 2 — Remove the "Setup Guide" tab from Settings **File:** [app/routes/app.settings.tsx](app/routes/app.settings.tsx) Current tabs array ([app.settings.tsx:276-281](app/routes/app.settings.tsx#L276-L281)): ```ts const tabs = [ { id: "general", content: "General" }, { id: "email", content: "Email" }, { id: "plan", content: "Plan & Usage" }, { id: "setup", content: "Setup Guide" }, // ← REMOVE ]; ``` Delete: - The `setup` entry from the array. - The entire `selectedTab === 3` rendered block (the 4-step setup checklist, ~lines 715-845 per Explore report). - Any unused imports left dangling after deletion (e.g. `CheckCircleIcon` if only used there — verify with grep before removing). The standalone `/app/onboarding` wizard and the dashboard `_index.tsx` "Complete your Pinzo setup" banner remain — they are the canonical onboarding surface. --- ## Change 3 — Replace top `` with a Polaris left-sidebar layout **File:** [app/routes/app.settings.tsx](app/routes/app.settings.tsx) ### Why a left sidebar (Polaris pattern) Shopify's own Admin Settings (`/admin/settings`) uses a left vertical menu + right content pane. This is the canonical Polaris pattern for settings-style pages with ≥4 sections.
